title: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme update
sections.summary: The speaker notes past schemes like HOPE and says 74 families have been emplaced under the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: We have experimented with different schemes before, such as the Home Ownership with Education (HOPE) scheme, which I previously raised issues with.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: We now have the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, which the Senior Parliamentary Secretary also updated the House that 74 families have now been emplaced.

sections.label: Rental to home ownership figures
sections.summary: The passage cites application and placement figures and contrasts 74 with 3,500 families progressing from rental to home ownership over six years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In December 2017, 56 applied, 33 were successful.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In December 2018, the Minister announced that 70 were placed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: If we look at the figures of the number of families which have progressed from rental to home ownership of 3,500 over the last six years, 74 seem very small, indeed.

sections.label: LBS extension to all flat types
sections.summary: The passage states further improvements were made in 2014 and LBS will be extended to all flat types from 1 January this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Further improvements were then made in 2014, and I was most heartened when Minister Lawrence Wong announced after last year's National Day Rally that LBS will be extended to all flat types effective 1 January this year.

sections.label: CPF use for shorter lease flats
sections.summary: The passage states the Ministry said in August 2018 it is studying liberalising CPF usage for older, shorter lease flats, and asks for an update.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The Ministry had earlier indicated in August 2018 that it is studying the possibility of allowing liberalisation of the usage of Central Provident Fund (CPF) for older, shorter lease flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I wish, therefore, to ask the Ministry for an update on the study so far and the parameters that the Ministry is looking at to make this work.

sections.label: ROF extension and application concerns
sections.summary: The passage welcomes the ROF being extended all year round and online on a first-come-first-served basis, and asks how the system will avoid opportunistic applications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: But I often caution younger residents who try for SBF that they are competing for a smaller pool with a bigger crowd, and yet they still try.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Therefore, I welcome the Ministry's announcement that the ROF will now be extended all year round and made available online on a first-come-first-served basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: However, I wish to ask how the Ministry intends for the system to work smoothly and avoid opportunistic applications rather than from those with genuine needs.

sections.label: Wait-out period waiver for divorcees
sections.summary: The passage states the recently announced waiver of the wait-out period is a Godsend for single-parents and divorcees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: For single-parents and divorcees, the waiver of the wait-out period that was announced recently is a Godsend.

sections.label: HDB estate redevelopment review
sections.summary: HDB is reviewing HIP 2 and the Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme, making it timely to consider redeveloping entire precincts or estates rather than making incremental changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: As HDB is in the process of reviewing the Home Improvement Programme (HIP) 2 and the Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme, it is timely to also consider the redevelopment of entire precincts or estates, instead of making incremental changes.

sections.label: Taller blocks in older estates
sections.summary: For many older estates close to the CBD, new blocks can be built taller to house more young families with members working in the CBD.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: For many older estates close to the Central Business District (CBD), the height of the new blocks can be increased to accommodate more young families who have members working in the CBD.

sections.label: Infrastructure transformation and renewal
sections.summary: Infrastructure transformation is needed to cope with climate changes such as higher temperatures and heavy rains, become more resource-efficient, and keep up with technological revolutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The transformation of our infrastructure is necessary to enhance our ability to cope with climate changes, including higher temperatures and heavy rains, and to become more resource-efficient, such as through the installation of solar panels and other energy-efficient measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Our city also needs to undergo infrastructural renewal to keep up with technological revolutions, such as the installation of charging points for electric vehicles.

sections.label: Opal Tower quality control lesson
sections.summary: The lessons of Opal Tower in Sydney and their wider implications for buildings across Australia are a timely reminder of the importance of quality control.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The lessons of Opal Tower in Sydney and its wider implications for buildings across Australia is a timely reminder of the importance of quality control.

sections.label: AVs, reclamation and sea levels
sections.summary: Widespread AV adoption could free up floors and raise lettable area, and the passage asks whether MND plans to raise the 2.25 metre reclamation requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Widespread adoption of AVs could free up several extra floors per building and create a 5% to 10% uplift in lettable area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: What impact would this have on low-lying coastal areas and on reclaimed land?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I remember the Minister for National Development's reply to a Parliamentary Question that I asked in 2011 in relation to rising sea levels that all new reclamation projects would have to be built to 2.25 metres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Does MND have any plans to raise this requirement further?

sections.label: BTO waiting times and family priority
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry would keep building BTO flats ahead for waiting times of 18 months or less and give priority by number of children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the Ministry continue to build Build-To-Order (BTO) flats ahead so that buyers can enjoy shorter waiting times of 18 months or less?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, for families wishing to upgrade to a bigger flat, can priority be given according to the number of children they have?

sections.label: Khatib HIP completion timing
sections.summary: Half of Khatib homes built in 1986 have HIP completed or near completion, while 1987 homes await HIP.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Half of Khatib homes were built in 1986 and the HIP has been completed or are near completion.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The other half of Khatib homes were built in 1987 where residents are still waiting for their HIP.

sections.label: Heavy vehicle parking spaces
sections.summary: An MP asks MND to increase parking spaces for heavy vehicles to match demand.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: On behalf of my residents, I would like to plead with MND to increase the number of parking spaces for heavy vehicles to match the demand.

sections.label: 2-room flats and singles
sections.summary: An MP asks how many 2-room flats HDB built and whether singles can buy 3-room flats.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Next, may I know how many 2-room flats has HDB built and how many singles are still waiting to buy 2-room flats?

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Will MND consider allowing singles to buy 3-room flats so that they can accommodate their elderly parents?

sections.label: Shared common spaces in estates
sections.summary: An MP asks HDB's plans for sufficient shared common spaces in newer estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: What we build today must be future-proof to meet the needs of tomorrow, and void decks and other wide spaces add to that flexibility for tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: So, can the Minister share with us what HDB's plans are to provision for sufficient shared common spaces in our newer estates?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: How is HDB designing newer estates so that neighbours can gather together, children can play together, families can celebrate together and, when there is a bereavement, people can say goodbye to loved ones near to their home and among neighbours?

sections.label: Rental flat income ceiling review
sections.summary: An MP urges a review of HDB's subsidised rental flat household income ceiling eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One of the eligibility criteria for an applicant to meet is a household income ceiling of $1,500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As for the latter, the ComCare Long-Term Financial Assistance Scheme amount will be increased.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: On this note, can I urge the Ministry to conduct a review of the HDB's subsidised rental flat household income ceiling eligibility criteria?

sections.label: Upgrading older rental flats
sections.summary: An MP urges MND to consider gradually upgrading older rental flats to improve residents' living environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Sometimes, there would be infestation of bed bugs, cockroaches and other pests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: I urge MND to consider plans to gradually upgrade the existing older rental flats to make the living environment better for the residents.

sections.label: Assessment of rental flat residents
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB can assess rental flat residents' needs to gradually upgrade rental flats to better serve them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Can HDB consider doing an overall assessment of the needs of rental flat residents so that we can gradually upgrade the rental flats to better serve their needs?

sections.label: Rental flat residents buying flats
sections.summary: Urges HDB to have a more flexible scheme for rental flat residents to buy over their existing flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: However, they were told by HDB that they could not do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: We should encourage all sitting rental flat residents to buy over their existing flats whenever they wish to do so as we should promote home ownership among them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: I urge HDB to have a more flexible scheme for rental flat residents to buy over their flat.

sections.label: Fresh Start Programme update
sections.summary: Asks the Minister for an update on the Fresh Start Programme, including problems such as complex rules.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: Indeed, if we do our job well, there may be many who see their lives improving substantially beyond 20 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: So, I would like to ask the Minister the following three questions: (a) An update on the Fresh Start Programme, including the problems encountered, such as the complexity of rules, and the difficulty in understanding them.

sections.label: Home loan and CPF eligibility
sections.summary: Says HDB home loan eligibility limits must increase and CPF should not be part of mortgage payments yet.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Second, their home loan eligibility limit with HDB has to be increased as it is unlikely they can qualify for a loan from the private banks.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Third, as many of these public rental tenants are low-income workers, they are usually on freelance jobs which do not contribute much to their CPF.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: So, CPF should not be part of their mortgage payment plan until they are able to build some sufficient funds.

sections.label: Rate based on payslip
sections.summary: States that sometimes the rate is increased based on the most recent payslip before tenancy renewal.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Sometimes, the rate is increased as it is based on the most recent payslip before tenancy renewal.

sections.label: Extending programmes to tenants
sections.summary: Says EASE, spalling concrete and leakage treatment should be extended to tenants like regular flat owners.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Existing programmes like the Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE), spalling concrete treatment and leakage treatment should be extended to these tenants readily without any difference compared to regular flat owners.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: I hope that MND's goal in helping these families will continue and would also like to know how many target households we are looking at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: A year before that, in a COS speech, the Minister for National Development said, "A couple of months ago, HDB announced that they were planning about 23,000 Build-To-Order (BTO) flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I decided to tell them to up the figure to 25,000 because I wanted to decisively clear the backlog of all married HDB first-timers this year." Sir, five years have passed, I am still hearing young couples, married or waiting to tie the knot, sharing about their difficulties of securing their matrimonial flat.

sections.label: HDB blocks without lift access
sections.summary: About 150 HDB blocks remain without direct lift access for all floors, per the last update in the House.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: From the last update we have in this House, there are about 150 blocks of HDB flats left without direct lift access for all floors.

sections.label: Hougang Block 363 lift shafts
sections.summary: Residents of Block 363 Hougang Avenue 5 are three additional lift shafts away from 100% lift access.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: Take, for example, residents of Block 363 Hougang Avenue 5 are just three additional lift shafts away from achieving 100% lift access.

sections.label: Bathroom upgrade cost and quality
sections.summary: Residents can pay as low as about $300 for bathroom upgrades, but low cost should not be linked to lower quality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: While residents can pay as low as about $300 to have their bathrooms completely upgraded with new tiles, piping and sanitary wares, they should not be made to correlate the low cost of upgrading with lower quality of fixtures or workmanship.

sections.label: Longer DLP for HIP defects
sections.summary: Affected residents should not pay again if issues resurface at the same spot shortly after one year, and HDB should consider a longer DLP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: Thus, affected residents should not be made to pay again if such issues were to resurface at the same spot shortly after one year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I hope HDB can look into having a slightly longer DLP for spalling concrete and water seepage problems that HIP is supposed to resolve.

sections.label: Ground floor laundry racks and HIP2
sections.summary: Ground floor residents near bin chutes prefer drying laundry elsewhere, so they should be consulted before new racks are installed by default; HIP2 is welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: Residents living on the ground floor also generally do not use these designated areas to dry their clothes as they are located right next to the bin chutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: They would prefer to dry their laundry elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: There are a number of such ground floor units in the two HIP clusters announced for Hougang Avenues 2, 5 and 7 and they are about to go through polling soon.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I hope residents living in those ground floor units can be consulted this time round before HDB proceeds to install those new racks by default.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: Next, I do welcome the announcement of a new HIP2 for qualifying flats at the 60- to 70-year mark.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: I may not be around to enjoy HIP2 but I do have faith that technology would play a big role in making those aged homes more liveable in the future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
sentences.text: So, apart from the standard spalling concrete and water seepage issues, which will probably return with vengeance after another 30 to 40 years, I hope HIP2 can make these old flats more elderly-friendly and smarter in energy consumption and safety.

sections.label: Resale prices 1990 versus 2018
sections.summary: Mean resale prices for a 4-room flat ranged from $60,000 to $95,000 in 1990 and $340,000 to $650,000 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: In 1990, mean resale prices for a 4-room flat ranged from $60,000 to $95,000.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: By 2018, the equivalent range was from $340,000 to $650,000.

sections.label: HDB towns price ranking
sections.summary: Eight of the top 10 HDB towns by price in 1990 remained in the top 10 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: Eight out of the top 10 HDB towns by price in 1990 are still in the top 10 in 2018.

sections.label: BTO discounts and income stratification
sections.summary: Large BTO discounts give windfall gains to those who can afford high-end HDB flats, and MND is asked about monitoring income stratification.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: Large BTO discounts cannot solve this completely because they just give windfall gains to those who can already afford a high-end HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: What is MND doing to monitor income stratification in HDB housing?

sections.label: CPF Housing Grant increases
sections.summary: HDB raised the CPF Housing Grant for first-timers buying resale flats and provides a $20,000 Proximity Housing Grant for young couples near parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: HDB has increased the CPF Housing Grant for first-timers buying resale flats from $30,000 to $50,000 for couples buying 4-room or smaller resale flats, and from $30,000 to $40,000 for couples buying 5-room or bigger resale flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: There is also the Proximity Housing Grant of $20,000 for young couples who buy a resale flat near parents within four kilometres (km).

sections.label: CPF Housing Grant means-testing
sections.summary: The CPF Housing Grant should not be means-tested since other grants already are, and both grants should be increased.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The CPF Housing Grant should not be subject to means-testing since the Additional CPF Housing Grant and Special CPF Housing Grant are already subject to means-testing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: I also hope that both the CPF Housing Grant and Proximity Housing Grant can be increased so that more couples would consider resale flats as an attractive option.

sections.label: Waiving mutual consent requirement
sections.summary: The Minister is asked to consider waiving the mutual consent requirement when shared care and control is awarded, especially for subsidised public housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Will the Minister consider waiving the mutual consent requirement when shared care and control is awarded by the Court, especially in cases where parties are only able to afford subsidised public housing?

sections.label: Retirement housing development guidelines
sections.summary: For private housing, the Ministry is reviewing development control guidelines to provide more clarity on retirement housing developments.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For private housing, the Minister said that the Ministry is reviewing development control guidelines to provide more clarity on retirement housing developments.

sections.label: Seniors selling flats, monetisation schemes
sections.summary: Asks whether HDB can help seniors in older mature estates sell flats, including via grants to same-ethnicity buyers, and seeks an update on elderly monetisation schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: To facilitate the sale of flats by seniors in older mature estates and, in the case of those not able to sell due to EIP, can HDB help facilitate by providing a grant or subsidy to same ethnicity buyers to consider buying the flats but only for seniors selling?

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: This will help ensure there is no horizontal dimension of inequality setting in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: I would also like to ask for an update on the uptake of the various schemes for the elderly to monetise their flats.

sections.label: Rest areas for outsourced workers
sections.summary: Minister of State Zaqy Mohamad said MOM will encourage building owners and service buyers to provide well-ventilated rest areas with basic furniture for outsourced workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Minister of State Zaqy Mohamad also shared yesterday that MOM will encourage building owners and service buyers to provide proper rest areas which are well-ventilated and equipped with basic furniture for the outsourced workers to store their personal belongings, rest and have their breaks.

sections.label: Rest areas exempted from DC
sections.summary: Proposes URA include Rest Areas in the list of items not counted as gross floor area and exempt them from development charges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: With the hefty DC, it can explain why most building owners do not carve out a rest area which has no commercial or intrinsic value to the owners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zainal Sapari (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Thus, I am proposing for the URA to include Rest Areas under the "List of Items not counted as gross floor area" and correspondingly be exempted from DC.

sections.label: Diesel tax increase shock
sections.summary: States that the announcement of the increase in diesel tax comes as a shock.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: The announcement of the increase in diesel tax comes as a shock.

sections.label: Rebate for diesel tax increase
sections.summary: Notes contractors are locked into competitive contract prices and incur overnight costs, and asks whether a rebate could absorb some impact.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Contractors are locked into very competitive existing contract prices and have to incur additional cost overnight.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Could there be some form of rebate that could absorb some of the impact from the increase?

sections.label: Variation order payments stuck
sections.summary: Says contractors report that due to strict audit checks by the Auditor-General's Office, many variation orders were stuck and payments unapproved despite completed work.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Contractors said due to recent strict audit check by the Auditor-General's Office, many variation orders submitted by them were stuck.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Work has already been done but nobody wants to approve the payment.

sections.label: Cat abandonment and enforcement
sections.summary: A recent case saw 11 cats abandoned overnight, and there is no licensing or microchipping requirement for cats, though a person was previously fined for abandoning her cat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: In one recent case, 11 cats were abandoned overnight.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: But there is difficulty with cats as there is currently no licensing or microchipping requirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: We have fined a person previously for abandoning her cat.

sections.label: Deterring cat abandonment measures
sections.summary: The question asks the Ministry to look into plans to strengthen measures to deter cat abandonment, such as microchipping and licensing pet cats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Can I ask the Ministry to look into plans to strengthen measures to deter cat abandonment, for instance, by microchipping and licensing pet cats?

sections.label: Assessing environmental impact of projects
sections.summary: The Minister said developers must conduct further studies and implement more mitigating measures if a project's potential environmental impact is assessed to be significant, and the question asks how and who will assess this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: The Minister replied that the Ministry will require developers to conduct further studies and implement more mitigating measures "if the potential environmental impact of a project is assessed to be significant." Can the Minister clarify how and who will assess the potential environmental impact of a project and how do we ascertain that further studies are required?

sections.label: MSO municipal services coordination update
sections.summary: The question asks MSO to update on how it has improved coordination and delivery of municipal services for residents, given it has run for more than four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Given that it has been running for more than four years now, could MSO update on how it has improved the coordination and delivery of municipal services for residents?

sections.label: OneService App adoption update
sections.summary: The question asks MSO to update on how widely the OneService App has been adopted since its inception and in which specific areas it has assisted users most effectively.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: In today’s context, where people are pressed for time and have little patience in waiting for things to get resolved, can MSO provide an update on how wide the adoption of the OneService App has been since its inception and in which specific areas has the app assisted its users most effectively?

sections.label: Analysing feedback data for improvements
sections.summary: Data collected from feedback through many channels can be more effectively analysed and applied for future designs, maintenance regimes, or to reduce recurrence of incidents.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: To take this further, a lot of data that is collected based on the feedback through many channels, can be more effectively analysed and applied for future designs, maintenance regimes or to reduce recurrence of incidents.

sections.label: Connecting agencies with caregivers
sections.summary: It proposes connecting the Silver Generation Office, Neighbourhood Community Police Post or other voluntary welfare organisations with caregivers or working family members to provide extended support.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Two, to connect the Silver Generation Office, the Neighbourhood Community Police Post or other voluntary welfare organisations in closer connection with the caregiver or the seniors' family members who are at work to provide the extended support if required.

sections.label: OneService app transformation
sections.summary: MSO announced it is transforming the OneService app into a one-stop community platform beyond reporting feedback, and a question asks for more information on its development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Last year, MSO announced that it is transforming the OneService app into a one-stop community platform beyond being a tool for reporting feedback in order to meet the needs of the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Could MSO provide more information on how it will further develop the app to meet the diverse and changing needs of residents?

sections.label: Community ownership and municipal issues
sections.summary: It asks how to encourage greater community ownership of the shared living environment and how MSO and municipal agencies have partnered residents on municipal issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: One, how do we encourage greater community ownership of the shared living environment?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Two, how have MSO and the municipal agencies been partnering residents to tackle municipal issues in the community?

sections.label: Analysing feedback for root causes
sections.summary: It asks whether MSO can analyse feedback data to assess the situation and identify the main root cause of ground issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Through the feedback data received by MSO, I wonder whether MSO is able to help analyse the information to assess the situation and identify the main root cause of issues that are happening on the ground.

sections.label: OneService app evidence for enforcement
sections.summary: It asks whether MSO can enhance the OneService app for the public to provide conclusive photographic or video evidence so the relevant agency can take enforcement action.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: For such cases, depending on the exact location, it could be HDB, LTA, Traffic Police or the Town Council which has the power to issue a summons against the errant motorist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: So, can MSO enhance the OneService app for the public to provide conclusive evidence of the offence, whether in the form of photographs or video?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: This could then help to alert the relevant agency to take the necessary enforcement action?

sections.label: OneService app usage and case figures
sections.summary: It states OneService app usage, reported cases, referral numbers, and average case resolution times, including 157,000 users and 288,000 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Residents can now conveniently access the services they need with the OneService app.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We now have 157,000 app users who have reported 288,000 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Today, about one in five municipal feedback received by Government agencies are reported through the app, double the one in 10 over two years ago.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: On average, cases are addressed within three working days.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With the inclusion of all Town Councils in September 2016, the number of cases referred among these systems has increased from about 5,000 cases per month then, to 14,000 cases per month last December.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Today, 90% of such complex cases are closed within 13 days, while the average time taken has fallen from 8.5 to 6.5 days over the past three years.

sections.label: OneService and youth challenges
sections.summary: MSO organised the OneService Innovation Challenge and Love Your Living Environment Youth Challenge, with residents contributing suggestions and working with agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Last year, MSO organised the OneService Innovation Challenge and the Love Your Living Environment Youth Challenge.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Residents from all walks of life came forward to contribute suggestions and work with agencies to implement ideas to deliver better services or tackle municipal issues.

sections.label: HelpBuddy app pilot
sections.summary: The HelpBuddy app pilot was launched last year for residents to take part in activities offered by agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We also want to encourage residents to do their part in improving their living environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We launched the HelpBuddy app pilot last year, where residents can take part in activities offered by agencies.

sections.label: OneService app and future services
sections.summary: If the pilot succeeds it will be incorporated into the OneService app, and partners will work to enable more convenient services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: If the pilot is successful, we will incorporate it in the OneService app.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To conclude, in the coming year, we will work closely with our partners to enable more convenient, effective and efficient services for residents.

sections.label: Nature Reserves and green buffers
sections.summary: NParks works with community partners on Nature Reserves and Areas, adding Nature Parks, planting native trees, and restoring habitats and species.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Second, on the planning level, we work with our community partners to protect and strengthen our Nature Reserves and Nature Areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We currently have six Nature Parks adjacent to our Nature Reserves to provide over 250 hectares of protective green buffers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: By 2020, we will add two more Nature Parks at Rifle Range and Thomson to increase our green buffers to over 370 hectares.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As part of our Forest Restoration Action Plan, NParks will plant an additional 250,000 native trees and shrubs to restore our secondary forests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In the past five years, NParks has planted an average of 50,000 trees a year, twice what it used to plant in the past.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It will restore and enhance more habitats, for example, restoring mangroves at Sungei Buloh and Pulau Ubin, and repopulating corals at Sisters Island Marine Park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will implement more species recovery plans and have started this for 50 species of native plants and 10 species of native animals.

sections.label: Pasir Ris Park population
sections.summary: There is a healthy new population at Pasir Ris Park, and work is underway to introduce more at East Coast Park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, there is a healthy new population at Pasir Ris Park, and work is underway to introduce more at East Coast Park.

sections.label: Tengah homes and jobs
sections.summary: Tengah was needed to provide homes over the next two decades for 42,000 families and jobs for more than 20,000 people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As was in the case of Tengah, which was needed to provide homes over the next two decades for 42,000 families and jobs for more than 20,000 people as the town develops progressively.

sections.label: EIA framework coverage areas
sections.summary: The EIA framework covers all Nature Reserves, Nature Areas, other sensitive natural areas, and marine and coastal areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Our EIA framework covers all Nature Reserves, Nature Areas, other sensitive natural areas, as well as marine and coastal areas.

sections.label: Public EIA findings
sections.summary: Findings of such EIAs will be made publicly available unless specific considerations require otherwise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In addition, to reiterate my previous answer to Members’ questions in this House, we will make the findings of such EIAs publicly available, unless specific considerations require otherwise.

sections.label: Volunteers caring for green spaces
sections.summary: Over 45,000 volunteers work closely with the government to protect and enhance greenery and nature areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: More and more citizens are stepping forward to care for our green spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are, indeed, fortunate to have over 45,000 volunteers who work closely with us to protect and enhance our greenery and nature areas.

sections.label: Former Bukit Timah Fire Station plans
sections.summary: Plans exist to develop the former Bukit Timah Fire Station into a recreational node along the Rail Corridor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, I am happy to share that we have plans to develop the former Bukit Timah Fire Station (BTFS) into an additional recreational node along the Rail Corridor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This former fire station is strategically located at the intersection of the Rail Corridor and the Coast-to-Coast Trail which we announced quite recently, too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And we envision it to be a base for visitors to explore the nature and heritage attractions in the area, including Bukit Timah Nature Reserve, Dairy Farm Nature Park and the Former Ford Factory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It will also be home to a new Visitor Centre for the nature parks in the area, and will host other nature, heritage and recreational uses and we will announce more details later this year.

sections.label: Punggol Town Hub facilities
sections.summary: The future Punggol Town Hub will feature a public library, community centre, hawker centre and health services co-located.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, the future Punggol Town Hub will feature a public library, community centre, hawker centre and health services, all co-located for one-stop, convenient access for residents.

sections.label: Construction and Real Estate ITMs
sections.summary: The Construction Industry Transformation Map and Real Estate ITM were launched in October 2017 and February 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In October 2017 and February 2018, we launched the Construction Industry Transformation Map (ITM) and the Real Estate ITM, which target to fundamentally change the way we design, build, maintain and rejuvenate our city while creating good jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: TAC action plans for Construction ITM
sections.summary: Six TACs have developed action plans to support the Construction ITM, with three more due to complete theirs by month's end.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Six TACs have developed their own action plans to support the Construction ITM and three more are due to complete theirs by the end of the month.

sections.label: BCA IMDA digital platform call
sections.summary: BCA and IMDA launched a $4 million joint call to support construction and technology firms developing digital platforms for the BE sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To address this, BCA and the Infocomm Media Development Authority have launched a $4 million joint call to support construction and technology firms in developing digital platforms for the BE sector as part of the IDD implementation plan launched in November last year.

sections.label: iBuildSG Tripartite Committee set up
sections.summary: Last month, BCA set up the iBuildSG Tripartite Committee to oversee implementation of leadership and talent development strategies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Last month, BCA set up the iBuildSG Tripartite Committee to oversee the implementation of leadership and talent development strategies.

sections.label: PPVC prefabrication and manpower savings
sections.summary: With PPVC, components are prefabricated in factories and assembled like Lego blocks, speeding onsite construction and saving up to 40% manpower.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: With PPVC, components are prefabricated under controlled factory conditions and assembled like Lego blocks, as Members can see on the screen.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This can significantly speed up onsite construction and save up to 40% manpower.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Model for lift industry
sections.summary: A PWM for the lift industry was announced last year, and Government will procure only from PWM-registered firms from May.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Last year, we announced a Progressive Wage Model (PWM) for the lift industry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In the meantime, the Government will take the lead to drive early PWM adoption by procuring only from firms that have registered their PWM status, starting this May.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So far, 21 lift companies have pledged their commitment towards PWM and I hope that more will join them.

sections.label: Reducing and removing MYE framework
sections.summary: The intent is to progressively reduce the MYE quota for onsite works and eventually remove the MYE framework altogether.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our intent is to progressively reduce the MYE quota for onsite works and eventually remove the MYE framework altogether.

sections.label: Offsite Construction Special Scheme introduced
sections.summary: A new voluntary Offsite Construction Special Scheme for DfMA facilities will be introduced to encourage more offsite works in the interim.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Meanwhile, to encourage more offsite works in the interim, we will introduce a new voluntary Offsite Construction Special Scheme (OCSS) for DfMA facilities.

sections.label: WSH regulations cut fatality rates
sections.summary: WSH regulations contributed to reducing construction workplace fatality rates from 8.1 per 100,000 workers in 2007 to 3.1 per 100,000 workers in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The WSH regulations have contributed to reducing construction workplace fatality rates from 8.1 per 100,000 workers in 2007 to 3.1 per 100,000 workers in 2018.

sections.label: Public sector projects boost construction demand
sections.summary: In 2017, it was announced that $1.4 billion worth of public sector projects would be brought forward to boost construction demand over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In 2017, we announced that we would bring forward $1.4 billion worth of public sector projects to boost construction demand over the next few years.

sections.label: Schemes consolidated under BuildSG Transformation Fund
sections.summary: Existing schemes will be consolidated under an umbrella BuildSG Transformation Fund amounting to about $770 million to help firms navigate the schemes more easily.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To help firms navigate the schemes more easily, we will consolidate our existing schemes under an umbrella BuildSG Transformation Fund (BTF) amounting to about $770 million.

sections.label: Additional funding for PIP
sections.summary: About $200 million will be added to PIP to support more firms adopting productive technologies, with another $95 million added to sustain the effort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The good news is that we will add about $200 million to PIP to support more firms in adopting productive technologies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Since its launch in 2017, most of the $154 million fund has been committed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We will add another $95 million to the fund to sustain the effort.

sections.label: ITMs strengthen Built Environment capabilities
sections.summary: The various ITMs under the Built Environment sector will strengthen the industry's capabilities in continuing to build and maintain quality infrastructure, with MND continuing to partner stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Going forward, the various ITMs under the Built Environment sector will strengthen the industry’s capabilities in continuing to build and maintain quality infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: MND will continue to partner our stakeholders as we ride the waves of transformation to a high-tech and a more productive BE sector.

sections.label: Number doubled over five years
sections.summary: The number almost doubled over the past five years, from about 700 in 2014 to about 1,300 last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The number almost doubled over the past five years, from about 700 in 2014 to about 1,300 last year.

sections.label: Fresh Start youngest child age limit
sections.summary: The age limit on the youngest child for Fresh Start applicants will be raised from 16 to 18.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: First, we will raise the age limit on the youngest child for Fresh Start applicants, from 16 to 18.

sections.label: New Fresh Start Support Programme
sections.summary: Support for Fresh Start families will be intensified through a new Fresh Start Support Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Second, we will intensify support for Fresh Start families through a new Fresh Start Support Programme.

sections.label: Criteria one year before key collection
sections.summary: They will need to meet all the criteria by one year before their key collection, estimated to benefit about 80 families over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: They will need to meet all the criteria by one year before their key collection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: We estimate that this will benefit about 80 families over three years.

sections.label: Rent charged at downpayment
sections.summary: They will continue to pay the rent charged at the time of downpayment, taking effect for tenancies commencing from 1 June 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: They will continue to pay the rent they were charged at the time when they made the downpayment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This will take effect for tenancies which commence from 1 June 2019.

sections.label: HDB corridor openings works
sections.summary: HDB will undertake works to create more openings along the corridors by removing some flats on each floor of such blocks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: To address this, HDB will undertake works to create more openings along the corridors, by removing some flats on each floor of such blocks.

sections.label: HDB flat for divorcing parties
sections.summary: HDB will let divorcing parties apply for a new flat with an Interim Judgment and settled ancillary matters, without waiting for Final Judgment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: HDB will now allow divorcing parties to apply for a new flat from HDB if they have an Interim Judgment and have settled the ancillary matters on their matrimonial property, and the custody, care and control of their children.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This means they no longer have to wait until the Final Judgment in order to apply for a flat.

sections.label: Single unwed parents housing
sections.summary: No single unwed parent in need of housing will be turned away at HDB's counters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For single unwed parents in need of housing, I assure Mr Louis Ng that no applicant will be turned away at HDB's counters.

sections.label: Public rental above income ceiling
sections.summary: In the last three years, 590 households were helped with public rental despite exceeding the income ceiling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In the last three years, 590 households were helped with public rental despite exceeding the income ceiling.

sections.label: Pet abandonment penalties and Project Love Cats
sections.summary: First-time pet abandonment can be fined up to $10,000 and/or jailed up to 12 months; CWS manages Project Love Cats in Chong Pang.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Persons convicted of pet abandonment can be fined up to $10,000 and/or imprisoned for up to 12 months for a first-time offence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Cat Welfare Society (CWS) currently manages Project Love Cats, a pilot community-owned responsible cat ownership programme in Chong Pang, with the support of Government agencies.

sections.label: AVA review of pet regulations
sections.summary: AVA intends a holistic review of the regulatory approach for pet issues, including promoting responsible ownership and deterring abandonment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In addition, AVA intends to undertake a holistic review of the regulatory approach for pet issues, including how to promote responsible pet ownership and deter abandonment.

sections.label: AVA and AWGs managing sites
sections.summary: Since its launch in November 2018, AVA and participating AWGs have managed operations at various sites across Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Since its launch in November 2018, AVA and participating AWGs have been managing the operations at various sites across Singapore.

sections.label: AVA animal wildlife management reorganisation
sections.summary: AVA will keep animal and wildlife management science-based and balanced, strengthened by combining its veterinary science with NParks' ecology expertise from 1 April 2019.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: AVA will continue to ensure that animal and wildlife management strategies are grounded in science and balance the needs and interests of various stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This will be further strengthened with the upcoming reorganisation of AVA's functions from 1 April 2019, as AVA's veterinary science capabilities will be combined with the National Parks Board's (NParks’) expertise in ecology and conservation.

sections.label: Post-independence long-term urban plans
sections.summary: Earlier plans were limited and could not meet growing housing and employment needs, so after Independence Singapore made its own long-term urban plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But these plans were limited in scope and were unable to address our growing housing and employment needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And that is why after Independence, we established our own long-term urban plans for the whole of Singapore.

sections.label: Draft Master Plan 2019 exhibition
sections.summary: URA will launch the Draft Master Plan 2019 exhibition later this month and looks forward to public feedback and inputs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) will launch the Draft Master Plan 2019 exhibition later this month and we look forward to public feedback and inputs on these plans.

sections.label: HDB rejuvenation projects HIP 2 VERS
sections.summary: Long-term projects announced last year to rejuvenate older HDB flats and estates include HIP 2 and VERS, with details still being worked out.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Last year, we announced some significant long-term projects to rejuvenate our HDB flats and estates as they get older.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They include initiatives like the Home Improvement Programme (HIP) 2 and Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme (VERS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: These are major long-term undertakings and will need time to work out the details, taking feedback and suggestions, and we will provide an update when we are ready.

sections.label: MND monitors HDB flat affordability
sections.summary: MND monitors indicators closely and is committed to HDB flat affordability and accessibility, with first-timers in non-mature estates succeeding within two to three tries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) monitors these indicators closely and we are committed to ensuring the affordability and accessibility of HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today, all first-timers applying for a BTO flat in a non-mature estate are successful within two to three tries.

sections.label: BTO pricing discounts and grants
sections.summary: Most first-timers succeed within two tries and all within three; BTO flats are priced at discounts with grants up to $80,000 and mortgage service ratio under 25%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In fact, the vast majority get it within two tries and 100% within three tries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We continue to price these BTO flats at significant discounts to market, and we offer generous grants of up to $80,000 for first-timers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The mortgage service ratio for first-timers in these non-mature estates is less than 25%.

sections.label: Single applicant application rates
sections.summary: Application rates for singles fell from about 38 times to slightly over four times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: When we started, application rates were about 38 times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Now, the application rates for singles are slightly over four times.

sections.label: HDB balloting time shortened
sections.summary: HDB reviewed its processes and cut balloting time from six weeks to three weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I spoke about this last year and I challenged HDB to shorten the balloting time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, I am very happy to share that HDB has done a fundamental review of its processes and it has succeeded in reducing the time taken from six weeks to three weeks.

sections.label: Shorter waiting time flats doubled
sections.summary: The number of shorter waiting time flats is being doubled to 2,000 this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Indeed, we would like to do so and are doubling the number of shorter waiting time flats to 2,000 this year.

sections.label: Open ROF pool booking
sections.summary: Flat buyers can book flats from an open ROF pool at any time from June this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Last month, I shared that we will be allowing flat buyers to book flats from an open ROF pool at any time of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This will start from June this year, and we will share the details of how to go about the application process in due course.

sections.label: Resale flat family grants
sections.summary: Grants of up to $120,000 are available for some families buying a resale flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In total, grants of up to $120,000 are available for some families buying a resale flat.

sections.label: Step-Up CPF Housing Grant expanded
sections.summary: The $15,000 Step-Up Grant will be expanded to cover second-timer families in rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today we have a Step-Up CPF Housing Grant (SUHG) of $15,000, which is a specific scheme to help households who own 2-room flats in non-mature estates who wish to buy a larger 3-room flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will expand the Step-Up Grant to cover second-timer families in rental flats because we want to do more to help these families move back to home ownership.

sections.label: Rental block upgrading programmes
sections.summary: Rental blocks older than 30 years have undergone MUP, HIP and LUP, with extra works, EASE and free repairs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: All rental blocks older than 30 years have undergone upgrading programmes, such as the Main Upgrading Programme (MUP), Home Improvement Programme (HIP) and Lift Upgrading Programme (LUP).

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In fact, we do more with rental flats with specific improvement works that go beyond the scope of HIP, such as the installation of new tiles and new windows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We also provide Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) and repairs of spalling concrete and ceiling leaks for free.

sections.label: Partitions for all JSS units
sections.summary: Positive tenant feedback led HDB to make partitions available for all JSS units in existing and new rental blocks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The feedback from these tenants has been positive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, HDB will make available these partitions for all JSS units, in both existing and new rental blocks.

sections.label: Lease Buyback scheme payout
sections.summary: After keeping 25 years of lease and selling the rest to HDB, they topped up CPF for about $950 monthly for life.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On top of that, they have been living in the estate for the past 32 years and are familiar with the surroundings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, with LBS, after keeping 25 years of their lease and selling the remainder to HDB, they were able to top up their respective CPF Retirement Accounts, which means they get a payout of about $950 per month for life.

sections.label: Relaxing CPF usage rules
sections.summary: If done, CPF usage rules can be relaxed even if the remaining lease is under 60 years, with details announced soon.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If that is done, then we can relax CPF usage rules, even if the remaining lease is less than 60 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The details are being worked out, and we will announce them soon for implementation in May this year.

sections.label: Assisted living pilot at Bukit Batok
sections.summary: Feedback will be taken, with the assisted living pilot at Bukit Batok launching next year and private site models explored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will take in feedback and views from the discussions and ensure that seniors will welcome such an option, and that the model will be sustainable for the service providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will work towards the launch of our assisted living pilot site for public housing at Bukit Batok next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have also been exploring such retirement housing models for private residential sites.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are studying potential sites to pilot these assisted living typologies which include, as suggested by Mr Murali Pillai, the option of converting vacant school sites into retirement homes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We do not want them to take the site, build something and sell the units because, with assisted living, these have to be a package of services plus residential combined together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will need to craft the appropriate rules and safeguards to ensure that this happens.

sections.label: Next phase of HIP
sections.summary: HIP pace was ramped up to complete upgrading for flats built up to 1986, all announced by end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah and Mr Png Eng Huat asked about our plans for HIP, particularly the next phase of HIP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have ramped up the pace of HIP to complete upgrading for flats built up to 1986.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: All such flats will be announced for HIP by end of this year.

sections.label: Home Improvement Programme scope
sections.summary: The next HIP batch covers 230,000 flats with a fully government-paid essential component and a highly subsidised optional component, announced next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The scope of works will be the same as the existing HIPs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: There will be an essential component, covering things like spalling concrete, waste pipe replacement, electrical load upgrading which will be fully paid for by the Government and there will be an optional component covering bathroom upgrading and door replacement, which will be highly subsidised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: There are a total of 230,000 flats in this batch, so we are starting the announcement next year.

sections.label: Estate Upgrading Programme private estates
sections.summary: Private estates are upgraded through the Estate Upgrading Programme, with the next batch selected by the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: As Er Dr Lee Bee Wah highlighted, we also upgrade private estates through the Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP).

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will select estates for the next batch of EUP by the second half of this year and we will continue to review and see what more can be done for private estates.

sections.label: Greenery, parks and park connectors
sections.summary: Singapore has over 4,000 ha of gardens and parks and 3,300 ha of nature reserves, and is expanding green spaces and park connectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Today, we have more than 4,000 hectares (ha) of gardens and parks, 3,300 ha of nature reserves, all linked together with park connectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: As Minister Desmond Lee highlighted yesterday, we are continuing to maintain and enhance our greenery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are continuing to expand our green spaces and our network of park connectors, for example, with the Coast-to-Coast trail and first segment of the Round Island Route ready this year, and we are working to ensure seamless connection along a large stretch of the rail corridor up to Tanjong Pagar by 2021.

sections.label: Projected sea level rise
sections.summary: UN projections say uncurbed emissions could raise sea levels around one metre by 2100, and around 0.7 metres even under the Paris Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: According to projections by the United Nations panel, if global emissions continue on their current trajectory uncurbed, sea levels could rise by around one metre in 2100.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Even if countries pursue all the measures committed under the Paris Agreement – and that is a big "if" – sea levels are still going to rise, albeit at a lower level of around 0.7 metres.

sections.label: Long-term infrastructure protective measures
sections.summary: The full extent of needed infrastructure is being sized up, with protective measures to be put in place within 20 to 30 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are sizing up the full extent of the infrastructure that is needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: These are long-term investments, but we are preparing well ahead and putting in place the necessary protective measures within the next 20 to 30 years.

sections.label: Paya Lebar and Greater Southern Waterfront land
sections.summary: Airbase relocation frees 800 ha at Paya Lebar and port movement frees 1,000 ha, with the Greater Southern Waterfront totalling 2,000 ha.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: At Paya Lebar, the relocation of the airbase will free up 800 ha of land and remove current height restrictions around the area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For the Greater Southern Waterfront, the movement of ports will free up 1,000 ha.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Altogether, the footprint of the Greater Southern Waterfront is 2,000 ha of prime waterfront land, six times the size of Marina Bay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For the Paya Lebar site, work will only start after 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For the Greater Southern Waterfront, the project will take more than 20 years, but we will make some moves within the next five to 10 years.

sections.label: Home Ownership Support Team conditions
sections.summary: The Home Ownership Support Team will be set up later this year, reaching about 1,000 families, with conditions similar to FSSP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: Could the Senior Parliamentary Secretary update the House on the ambit of this Team and what are the conditions that the Team will be looking at to identify households that can potentially become home owners?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I mentioned in my earlier speech a couple of days ago that we are looking to set up the Home Ownership Support Team later this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We hope to reach out to about 1,000 families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As to the conditions that they will consider, it is quite similar to FSSP.

sections.label: HDB flat sale signatures
sections.summary: HDB cannot act on a flat sale without both legal owners' signatures; a resident may apply to vary a Court Order.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As both parties are legal owners of the flat, HDB cannot act on the sale without the signatures of both parties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For the example that the Member mentioned, it is possible for the resident to apply for a variation of the Court Order, like I mentioned in my speech, to include a provision for the Registrar of the Court to sign on behalf of the uncooperative party.

sections.label: Design for Maintainability Checklist cleaners
sections.summary: The Design for Maintainability Checklist encourages designated rooms for cleaners to rest and store items, though DC exemptions have limits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: The Building and Construction Authority's Design for Maintainability Checklist already encourages provision of designated rooms of sufficient size for cleaners to both rest and store their personal items.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: I think for the long haul, there are limitations on the use of DC exemptions to promote specific use.

sections.label: Public housing in central area
sections.summary: When redeveloping HDB flats in the central area, public housing will continue to be injected there, in small pockets and bigger plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, certainly, where you see HDB flats today in the central area, be it rental or sold flats, at some point in time, when we redevelop, we do intend to continue injecting public housing in these same areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have already been doing so in small pockets and will plan to do so in a bigger way with long-term rejuvenation.

sections.label: Income ceiling for public housing
sections.summary: The income ceiling aims to manage fiscal resources prudently and ensure public housing for at least 80% of the population, and is updated over time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, as Mr Murali Pillai highlighted, the intent behind the income ceiling is really to ensure that we manage our fiscal resources prudently and we ensure that there is public housing for at least 80% of the population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And the income ceiling continues to be updated over a period of time.

sections.label: Grants for affected rental blocks
sections.summary: Improvement works target blocks built in the 1960s and 1970s, a subset of all rental blocks, in response to a question on shifting grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: And the last question is: would there be any grants to help those who are affected to shift?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I have mentioned in my speech that the improvement works we are looking at are for blocks built in the 1960s and 1970s.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, it will be a subset of the entire stock of rental blocks that we have.

sections.label: Improvement works preparation start
sections.summary: Preparation works for improvement works are expected to start in the later part of this year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As for the preparation works for the improvement works, we are looking to start this in the later part of this year.

sections.label: Criteria for single unwed applications
sections.summary: The speaker hopes to specify criteria for accepting or rejecting applications to give single unweds certainty, after reviewing past EIAs, with something out this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, I am hoping that moving forward, maybe we can just specify some criteria where applications will be accepted and where they will be rejected, so that there will be some certainty to the single unweds rather than just saying that we will exercise flexibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It requires us to look at the entire process to understand the experience of the last few EIAs and we will endeavour to put something out this year.

sections.label: Holistic help for single unwed parents
sections.summary: The approach is case-specific and holistic, aiming to help single unwed parents with children have a roof over their heads.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: It is very case-specific and very specific to the individual, but it is a very holistic approach.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And our main aim is to be helpful and to ensure that single unwed parents with children will have a roof over their heads.

sections.label: Tiered CPF housing grants
sections.summary: CPF housing grants are tiered to be more progressive, with larger grants for 3- or 4-room flats and smaller grants for bigger flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, we have tiered the CPF housing grants simply to make it a more progressive measure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, for those who are buying 3- or 4-room flats, they will get a larger grant, and if you are buying a bigger flat, we size it a bit smaller.

sections.label: Maintaining loan quantum for lower incomes
sections.summary: If incomes have come down but means to service the loan exist, the same quantum may be maintained or not reduced so much.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Even if their incomes have somewhat come down, so long as they have the means to service the loan, then we will try to, perhaps, even with lower incomes, still consider maintaining the same quantum or not reducing it so much, so that they can still afford the flat that they had earlier purchased.

sections.label: Rental application time
sections.summary: In general, the rental application time is about two to three months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In general, the rental application time is about two to three months.

sections.label: Singles and 3-room flats
sections.summary: MND reviews options for singles applying for 3-room flats but prioritises clearing demand for 2-room flexi flats first.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, on singles applying for 3-room flats, I would say that MND considers all these options continuously as we review our policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But let us now start by clearing the demand for 2-room flexi flats first.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That is the priority for now, and I would not want to commit to another extension of the 3-room flats, and then have another backlog building up, and we will be running after so many different queues with insufficient supply to meet the demand.

sections.label: HIP schedule 1987 to 1997 flats
sections.summary: Town Councils will be invited to nominate the first batch of 1987 to 1997 flats later this year, with an announcement next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the HIP schedule for the flats built from 1987 to 1997, I said we would make the announcement in 2020, which actually means we will be inviting all the Town Councils to select and nominate the first batch of 1987 to 1997 flats by later this year, so that the announcement can be made next year.

sections.label: Duration of HIP batch
sections.summary: The previous round took about 13 years, and this batch of 1987 to 1997 flats will take more than 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: In that previous round, it took about 13 years, and I would think, barring unforeseen circumstances, it will take more than 10 years to complete this batch of 1987 to 1997 flats as well.

sections.label: Contracting of local suppliers
sections.summary: One goal is to help local contractors grow, and securing Government projects is one way to grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I will start off with the contracting of local suppliers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I mentioned yesterday that one of our goals is to help our local contractors grow, and securing Government projects is one way to grow.

sections.label: Local contractors winning Government projects
sections.summary: Lum Chang won a north-south corridor tunnel contract worth about $800 million, and Woh Hup won Kim Chuan depot's extension at about $1.21 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For example, Lum Chang Building Contractors won the design and construction contract for a section of the north-south corridor tunnel.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The awarded value is about $800 million, much higher than the $400 million threshold that the Member cited.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Woh Hup had also won in September 2017 the construction of Kim Chuan depot's extension to cater for Circle Line 6, which was about $1.21 billion.

sections.label: Build SG Transformation Fund
sections.summary: The Build SG Transformation Fund was announced yesterday as a way for contractors to develop.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is where I think they can develop.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: That is why if you look at the announcements yesterday, for example, we announced the Build SG Transformation Fund.
